import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long K;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] M;

        Matrix() {
            M = new long[0][0];
        }

        Matrix(int r, int c) {
            M = new long[r][c];
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < c; j++) {
                    M[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            M = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    M[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        int rows() {
            return M.length;
        }

        int cols() {
            return M.length == 0 ? 0 : M[0].length;
        }

        long[] getRow(int idx) {
            return M[idx];
        }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                res.M[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix other) {
            assert rows() == other.rows() && cols() == other.cols();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows(), cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < rows(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols(); j++) {
                    res.M[i][j] = (M[i][j] + other.M[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix other) {
            assert rows() == other.rows() && cols() == other.cols();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(rows(), cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < rows(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols(); j++) {
                    res.M[i][j] = (M[i][j] - other.M[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix other) {
            int r = rows(), c = other.cols(), m = cols();
            assert m == other.rows();
            Matrix res = new Matrix(r, c);
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < c; j++) {
                        res.M[i][j] = (res.M[i][j] + M[i][k] * other.M[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix power(long exp) {
            Matrix res = identity(rows());
            Matrix base = new Matrix(rows(), cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < rows(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols(); j++) {
                    base.M[i][j] = M[i][j];
                }
            }
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        long determinant() {
            Matrix C = new Matrix(rows(), cols());
            for (int i = 0; i < rows(); i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cols(); j++) {
                    C.M[i][j] = M[i][j];
                }
            }
            assert rows() == cols();
            long d = 1;
            int n = rows();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int p = -1;
                for (int j = i; j < n; j++) {
                    if (C.M[j][i] != 0) {
                        p = j;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (p == -1) return 0;
                if (i != p) {
                    d = (d * (MOD - 1)) % MOD;
                    long[] tmp = C.M[i];
                    C.M[i] = C.M[p];
                    C.M[p] = tmp;
                }
                d = (d * C.M[i][i]) % MOD;
                long inv = modInverse(C.M[i][i], MOD);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    C.M[i][j] = (C.M[i][j] * inv) % MOD;
                }
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    long f = C.M[j][i];
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        C.M[j][k] = (C.M[j][k] - C.M[i][k] * f) % MOD;
                        if (C.M[j][k] < 0) C.M[j][k] += MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return (d % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        private long modInverse(long a, long m) {
            long x = 0, y = 1, mm = m;
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                long q = a / m, t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x;
                x = y - q * x;
                y = t;
            }
            if (y < 0) y += mm;
            return y;
        }

        void transform() {
            Matrix Tmp = new Matrix(rows());
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    Tmp.M[i][j] = M[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                Tmp.M[i][(int)K] = M[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                Tmp.M[(int)K][i] = M[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            Tmp.M[(int)K][(int)K] = M[(int)K][(int)K];
            M = Tmp.M;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] pre = new Matrix[70][35];

    static long fastPow(long b, long e) {
        if (e == 0) return 1;
        long r = fastPow(b, e / 2);
        r = (r * r) % MOD;
        if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (r * b) % MOD;
        return r;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        long N_val = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();
        
        long depth = 0;
        long tmp = N_val;
        while (tmp >= K) {
            depth++;
            tmp /= K;
        }
        
        pre[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; i++) {
            pre[0][0].M[0][i] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            pre[0][i] = new Matrix(pre[0][i-1].rows(), pre[0][i-1].cols());
            for (int x = 0; x < pre[0][i-1].rows(); x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < pre[0][i-1].cols(); y++) {
                    pre[0][i].M[x][y] = pre[0][i-1].M[x][y];
                }
            }
            pre[0][i].transform();
        }
        
        for (long lvl = 1; lvl <= depth; lvl++) {
            pre[lvl][0] = new Matrix(pre[lvl-1][0].rows(), pre[lvl-1][0].cols());
            for (int x = 0; x < pre[lvl-1][0].rows(); x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < pre[lvl-1][0].cols(); y++) {
                    pre[lvl][0].M[x][y] = pre[lvl-1][0].M[x][y];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                pre[lvl][0] = pre[lvl-1][i].multiply(pre[lvl][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                pre[lvl][i] = new Matrix(pre[lvl][i-1].rows(), pre[lvl][i-1].cols());
                for (int x = 0; x < pre[lvl][i-1].rows(); x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < pre[lvl][i-1].cols(); y++) {
                        pre[lvl][i].M[x][y] = pre[lvl][i-1].M[x][y];
                    }
                }
                pre[lvl][i].transform();
            }
        }
        
        Matrix res = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        res.M[(int)K][0] = 1;
        int offset = 0;
        
        while (depth >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
                if (fastPow(K, depth) <= N_val) {
                    N_val -= fastPow(K, depth);
                    res = pre[(int)depth][offset].multiply(res);
                    offset = (offset + 1) % (int)K;
                } else break;
            }
            depth--;
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
            ans = (ans + res.M[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
